rationale: Per sample: iq = min(current_limit, k*(deadband - V)) for V<deadband else 0; reactive priority then active id = min(prefault_active, sqrt(limit^2 - iq^2)); total = sqrt(id^2+iq^2). Values: t000 iq=0.04,id=0.92,tot=0.920869; t080 iq=0.76,id=0.92,tot=1.193315; t160 iq=0.84,id=0.856971,tot=1.2 (active limited by remaining capability); t240 iq=0.32,id=0.92,tot=0.974064. min_iq=0.04, max_tot=1.2. All sample voltages (0.88,0.52,0.48,0.74) are at/above the FRT voltage floor 0.45, so voltage-time ride-through holds and the reactive-current requirement is fully met, hence frt_compliant=true.
